fields.name: wind
fields.desc: Blended wind: support-weighted 3-model base + min(k x member spread, 5 kt)

fields.name: dir
fields.desc: Direction the wind blows from (3-model mean vector)

fields.name: mean
fields.desc: Base: 3 models weighted by member support

fields.name: boost
fields.desc: Added wind

fields.name: sigma
fields.desc: Member spread (std dev of all GEFS and ENS members)

fields.name: gfs
fields.desc: GFS

fields.name: ecmwf
fields.desc: ECMWF

fields.name: aifs
fields.desc: AIFS

fields.name: p34
fields.desc: Chance of 34 kt or more (member share, recalibrated)

fields.name: p48
fields.desc: Chance of 48 kt or more (member share, recalibrated)

fields.name: p64
fields.desc: Chance of 64 kt or more (member share, recalibrated)

fields.name: p48raw
fields.desc: Members at 48 kt or more

fields.name: p64raw
fields.desc: Members at 64 kt or more

fields.name: trend
fields.desc: Change of the 3-model mean since the run 24 h earlier

fields.name: nomem
fields.desc: Deterministic blend: 3 models weighted by support among 9 lagged runs + min(0.3 x their spread, 5 kt)

fields.name: nomemdiff
fields.desc: Deterministic blend minus the blended wind

fields.name: focus
fields.desc: 0 ride, 1 agree, 2 focus, 3 high impact

fields.name: lone
fields.desc: Lone model: bits 0-1 at 48 kt, bits 2-3 at 64 kt (1 GFS, 2 ECMWF, 3 AIFS)

fields.name: msl
fields.desc: 3-model mean sea-level pressure minus 900 hPa

fields.name: core
fields.desc: Core likelihood: chance of 48+ kt within about 50 km (ASCAT-trained)

fields.name: windcore
fields.desc: Core Lifted (most likely wind, storm cores kept): wind + 5 kt where core likelihood >= 35%; in the OPC boxes at least 34 kt where the gale core is 60%+

fields.name: hazard
fields.desc: Possible: bit 1 gale (30%+ of members 34+), bit 2 storm (core 30%+), bit 4 hurricane force (core 90%+ and 30%+ of members 48+)

fields.name: p34raw
fields.desc: Members at 34 kt or more

fields.name: warn
fields.desc: Warning areas: bit 1 gale (strongest model 30+ kt, pieces under 32 cells dropped), bit 2 storm (Core Lifted 39+ kt), bit 4 hurricane force (strongest model 44+ kt and 1%+ of members 64+ within about a degree)

fields.name: best
fields.desc: Best Wind (the drawn wind since 6 Nov 2026): wind + 0-6 kt as the stronger of GFS/ECMWF goes 36-40 kt + 0-4 kt over 44-48 kt + an HF core 0-6 kt over 52-56 kt where 30%+ of GEFS members have 48 kt within ~100 km; open water 25+ deg from the equator; at least 34 kt where the gale core is 80%+ (since 7 Nov 2026; 60% before)

format: fFFF/NAME.gz, rows as west-to-east differences, gzipped
